verdict.rationale: Turso is a database platform, not an agent or orchestrator that itself consumes MCP servers' tools; the evidence entirely concerns Turso exposing its own official MCP server for AI agents to connect to and manage Turso resources (turso-docs-9, turso-docs-37, turso-probe-4, turso-probe-rt-3), which is the reverse (server) role, not the client-side 'plug MCP servers into this product' story.
